snippet.title: The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria™ - Durin's Folk - SDCC Exclusive
snippet.description:
**EXCLUSIVE NEWS FROM SAN DIEGO COMIC CON!**

Game Director Jon-Paul Dumont joined the SDCC panel “Middle-earth: The Adventure Ahead” and shared exciting news about the upcoming story expansion for Return to Moria! 

The expansion, titled “Durin’s Folk” is coming soon! Continue the fight to restore Moria with an expanded end-game story, exciting new game mechanics, plus many unrevealed secrets! 

Wishlist today and keep an eye on our Discord for more information about the expansion, coming soon! 

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3874660/The_Lord_of_the_Rings_Return_to_Moria_Durins_Folk_Expansion 

Discord: https://discord.gg/6TNP7as9md 

----- 

The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria, the only survival crafting game set in the Fourth Age of Middle-earth™, the iconic fantasy world created by J.R.R. Tolkien. 

Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/the-lord-of-the-rings-return-to-moria-f01344  

PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10008445/  

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2933130/The_Lord_of_the_Rings_Return_to_Moria/  

Xbox Store: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/the-lord-of-the-rings-return-to-moria/9N96T1S3L9SB 

Find out more at www.ReturnToMoria.com
